A '''speeder bus''' or '''hoverbus''' was a vehicle that transported individuals. [[Speeder/Legends|Speeder]] buses served as public transport on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]], located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> The [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] featured such vehicles.<ref name="AOTC">{{Film|II}}</ref>
